title: Reverse Cultivation
summary: The Demon General Tournament opens on the Grand Plaza of Sky Demon City under the steward Jin Wuxu and the sixteen Commanders-in-Chief: each Demon General fights, then his assistant, and Demon Generals may not be killed but assistants can be. Shi Xiao easily beats Mu Yun and kills Mu Yun's assistant Master Tiankui of the Giant Spirit Sect, then calls Wang Lin a toy. Vice Commander-in-Chief Xuan bets Vice Commander-in-Chief Huang his Heavenly Omen Banners that Wang Lin will win the whole tournament. Demon General Ao Di challenges Wang Lin and fires his life-bound serpent's Blood God Arrow; Wang Lin blocks it and cripples him without killing him, and with four wins Mo Lihai goes through to the second round. In the city Wang Lin's sword spirit Xu Liguo chases the Emperor Sword Spirit until Wang Lin reins him in, and some assistants who are quitting the tournament tell Wang Lin to go with the flow. Thinking it over alone, he decides that every step from Qi Condensation to the peak of Soul Transformation came from defiance, and that reverse cultivation against heaven is his road to Ascendant.
events: Jin Wuxu opens the tournament and explains the rules
Shi Xiao beats Mu Yun and kills his assistant Master Tiankui
Vice Commander-in-Chief Xuan bets Vice Commander-in-Chief Huang that Wang Lin will win
Wang Lin blocks Ao Di's Blood God Arrow and cripples him
Mo Lihai advances with four wins
Xu Liguo flirts with the Emperor Sword Spirit and is restrained by Wang Lin
Assistants say goodbye and urge Wang Lin to go with the flow
Wang Lin chooses defiance as his path to Ascendant
cultivation: Jin Wuxu: mid Ascendant, 400,000 armor. Vice Commander-in-Chief Huang: early Ascendant. Mu Yun, Master Tiankui and Ao Di: late Soul Transformation. Wang Lin: peak Soul Transformation.
